sources.searcher_note: Database page, not an article; lists CareCore homes with health-inspection counts and fines (data updated August 2026). No fire-safety or Life Safety Code figures on the page.

sources.quote: During our onsite inspections, we identified deficiencies related to life safety, emergency preparedness, or infection control at 18 of the 20 nursing homes that we audited, totaling 160 deficiencies.
sources.searcher_note: OIG audit A-05-22-00019 of 20 Ohio nursing homes: 47 life-safety deficiencies; homes not named.

sources.quote: Sprinkler system maintenance (prevalence: 21% of all facilities cited)
sources.searcher_note: Vendor-written trade piece: sprinkler maintenance is the most common Life Safety Code citation nationally; fire alarm testing is #9. General, no chain named.

notes: Nothing found naming CareCore Health for fire-safety citations, repeat tags, or a comparison with the Ohio rate. The only source naming the entity is ProPublica's affiliate database page (10 homes, not 12), which carries no fire-safety data. Local searches (Lima, Dayton, Chillicothe, Mentor) turned up only directory and rating pages. An Ohio Department of Health 2021 survey-and-enforcement PDF surfaced in search with K353/K345 citation counts, but the URL returned 404 on fetch, so it is not recorded. No disagreeing or post-2026-06-30 coverage found.
